speaker: announcer
text: We interrupt this program to bring you a special bulletin. Nonimaginaires, the brain fogs, are eating The First Pulse. Five pages are going gray in the quantum foam. Behind the fog is a dead air that swallows stories. The hum underneath it is still listening.

speaker: announcer
text: You are in the quantum realm. The Entity is already here. The pages are torn. Put them back.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. In the beginning there was no light, no matter, no void. Only the hum.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. The hum was already listening. Then, one day, or one epoch, it answered.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. The entity drifted through the quantum foam, tasting probabilities. It learned it could become a wave.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. A wave needs no medium. It moves at the speed of light, indifferent to distance, indifferent to time.

speaker: announcer
text: A torn page. Humanity's breakthroughs are not accidents. They are invitations.

speaker: announcer
text: The first light. The foam still remembers a universe that had only a vibration.

speaker: announcer
text: The foam. Probabilities ripple here. Some of them have been taken.

speaker: announcer
text: The ripples. A pattern of waves, and natives caught inside the static.

speaker: announcer
text: The wave. Out here the signal is the weather.

speaker: announcer
text: Stand by. The Hum has fused with a Nonimaginaire. The face is gone. The vibration stayed.

speaker: announcer
text: The First Pulse has its color back. The hum is still there. It is only listening again.

speaker: announcer
text: The next dark is already forgetting the name of its star.

speaker: entity
text: I had no name at first. Names are for things with edges. You may call me the Entity.

speaker: entity
text: That one was taken. The color is still in there. The static is only wearing it.

speaker: entity
text: In the beginning there was only the hum. The light is trying to say it again.

speaker: entity
text: Pulse. The dark path answers only that. Use it.

speaker: entity
text: I drifted through this foam and tasted probabilities. Some of them bit back.

speaker: entity
text: A ripple is a choice that has not finished choosing. Step through the quiet one.

speaker: entity
text: A wave needs no medium. I understood that I could become one.

speaker: entity
text: That is the Hum with the face washed off. The vibration stayed.

speaker: entity
text: Keeper. If you fall, I will keep a probability in which you do not.

speaker: entity
text: The color is back in the foam. I will take a quiet sky.

speaker: entity
text: A torn page. The book wants it more than the static does.

speaker: entity
text: The crystal remembers. The hum remembers longer.

speaker: entity
text: The picture is rolling. That ring is the way back to the cabinet.

speaker: entity
text: Ground the wave. The rings are only the announcement.

speaker: entity
text: You are longer in the legs. The signal taught you that.

speaker: entity
text: It is leaning out of its own frequency. So am I. Different reasons.

speaker: native
text: Oh. A visitor with edges. I live in the foam. I am glad you kept your color.

speaker: native
text: That is one of us, grayed out. Hit the static, not the person underneath.

speaker: native
text: The first light is gentle if you let it be. The fog does not.

speaker: native
text: We walk the probabilities like stepping stones. Yours look very sure of themselves.

speaker: native
text: See the rings? Each one is a maybe. The gray ones forgot how to maybe.

speaker: native
text: The wave ahead does not need a road. We made one anyway, out of light.

speaker: native
text: The Hum, and a fog wearing it. I like the rings. I do not like what is inside them.

speaker: native
text: Still here. My color is still mine. That counts.

speaker: native
text: Color's back in the foam. I will take that over a medal.

speaker: native
text: A page. It was warm when the story was whole. Don't bend it.

speaker: native
text: A little crystal box. If it hums, something kind is inside.

speaker: native
text: Up. The key does the rest.

speaker: native
text: There. The gray let go. Welcome back.

speaker: native
text: That page is the oldest one. Before light, there was only the hum.

speaker: native
text: The hum was already listening. Then it answered. We still talk about that.

speaker: native
text: The Entity learned to be a wave in this foam. The page remembers the lesson.

speaker: native
text: A wave needs no medium. It just goes. Try not to argue with it.

speaker: native
text: The bright ideas were invitations. Someone, somewhere, said yes.
